notes.title: Small Update 4.24.24
notes.notes:
Another update with some small changes--

[list]
[*]It is now possible to disable the second player controller with an option in controller settings. This will prevent the game from detecting inputs or activating a second controller. 
[*]You can now choose to enable a speed run timer in the regular (non-time attack) mode. You still have to be in time attack mode (using the skates) to get the achievements with it, though. :)
[*]When you finish a game, the autosave slot will now reset the end game trigger events and place you back at the mansion's front yard, so if you want to explore more or play mini games, you don't have to start over.
[/list]

notes.title: Update note for 4/13/24
notes.notes: Fixed a bug where the life counter and timer display during the microgames was not working correctly on certain systems.

notes.title: Patch Note 4/1/24
notes.notes: Fixed a bug that could cause a softlock if you talked to the synthesizer player and collected the crawlbot parts in a certain order. Thanks to the Shady Corner Discord for spotting it! A few other small bugs (like walking "on top" of the shack in the backyard) that were corrected for the Switch version have also been corrected here. If you ever want to confirm you've got the latest version, hold F1 at the title screen and it'll display the date of your version.

notes.notes:
Small changes but an important bug fix, the Fast or its Free achievement wouldn't trigger if you had turned off the nude photos. 
While at it, I have made the sexy leg's movement in the workout minigame slightly less random and less likely to "guard" certain areas.

notes.title: Boo Party Update
notes.notes:
Hey everybody! I've been plugging away at some mini game changes that will hopefully keep us all chill and vibing.

Previously, there were ways to reduce the difficulty of the dance and arcade minigames, but this wasn't at all apparent, it was something you had to poke around a lot to learn. There are some other adjustments (Succu Bouncer now even has a brief tutorial) but the big thing is that if you seem to be struggling, the game will tell you about those options, and some new options have been created for the tubing and workout games as well that should take some of the pressure off.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41008592/25c4b15f4ca434c23411d5d5a0bd2dd5b3b91fa4.png[/img]

But, I got a messages from people who'd already had enough, and from the sound of it the last thing they wanted to do is spend more time on those minigames. So you can skip them entirely if you want, with a setting in the option menu. There's no penalty for setting it, or for skipping them. (Well, there is a little time cost if you do it in time attack mode..) So, please play the game how you want.

Also, just a little reminder, Steam's algorithm loves reviews and they're a big help to a game's visibility. So if you don't mind posting a review for this sort of game, please do! It will definitely help out.

Thanks again for playing Boo Party!
